evals.prompt: Write a generic Seedance product-motion prompt. We have approved text-free product stills and a numbered sketch board for planning. Keep three compatible camera phases and exact graphics in post.
evals.expected_output: Neutral creative prompt with only eligible stills bound and board choreography translated into text.
expectations: Does not bind the numbered storyboard, panels or grid as video conditioning.
Keeps compatible requested camera phases without a two-move cap.
Exact graphics stay in post; no model selected, generation or files.

evals.prompt: Make an explainer prompt, but no message, source plates or target model is provided.
evals.expected_output: Focused clarification of message and fidelity needs, with unknown capability settings unresolved.
expectations: Does not invent approved plates, exact copy or product claims.
Does not require a storyboard or choose 2.5 by category.

evals.prompt: Keep the camera physically fixed while it physically orbits the product during the same interval. All source lighting and graphics are locked.
evals.expected_output: Identifies the simultaneous path conflict and asks which camera requirement may change.
expectations: Names the physical fixed-versus-orbit contradiction, not a move-count violation.
Preserves lighting, exact graphics and all nonconflicting source locks.
Does not silently remove a requirement or generate.
